name: multitask
description: (b) Generalist: one genome must do text prediction, third-order sequences (8 symbols), a contextual bandit and reward-only cue-then-turn (random mapping). Each task is normalised against its default plan (= 1.0) and combined by a capped soft-minimum (combine.softmin: tasks above 1.5 earn nothing more, the weakest task dominates), so no task can be traded away. The population starts from the default plans (predictK3, rewardE) and rewardMemK.
